# Results — Study 830 (BAB Across Asset Classes)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), extended to the multi-asset level: a **flat security-market
line** is not stocks-only; sort asset classes by their beta to a common multi-asset market
and a beta-neutral **long-low-beta / short-high-beta** book should earn a positive alpha.
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. Stamped as-of 2026-06-30 (the last complete calendar month; the partial current month
is dropped). Fingerprint `c502a478deee` (cross-asset close frame).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily total-return closes (`auto_adjust=True`), **9 asset-class ETFs**, 2007-04-11 → 2026-06-30, **4,836** dated rows |
| Universe | SPY (US equity), EFA (dev-ex-US), EEM (EM equity), TLT (long Treasuries), LQD (IG credit), HYG (high-yield), GLD (gold), DBC (commodities), VNQ (US REITs); the **multi-asset market** is their equal-weight average |
| Signal | each asset's **Frazzini-Pedersen rolling beta** to the equal-weight market: `beta = 0.6·(ρ·σ_i/σ_m) + 0.4`, ρ over 252d, σ over 63d, shrunk toward 1; known at the close of `t−1` (one `shift`) |
| Book | rank by beta; FP rank weights **long the low-beta side (levered by 1/β_L)**, **short the high-beta side (de-levered by 1/β_H)**, each leg scaled to unit beta and netted (risk-free ≈ 0) |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: betas through close `t−1` → hold day `t`. The costed timer charges realized daily turnover × one-way cost × NAV on the ~2.6×-gross levered book; short leg pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 10-lag) *t* on the daily BAB return; one-sample *t*; a HAC CAPM alpha (BAB on the market); a 1,000-permutation placebo; a two-era cut; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** The nine ETFs are a **current-membership** set
of liquid, still-listed asset-class proxies; the multi-asset "market" is their equal-weight
average. Magnitudes are an upper bound (no delisted vehicles). This is a *cross-asset-class*
BAB, not the stock-cross-section original.

## The headline — the beta-neutral BAB factor

Daily long-low-beta (levered) / short-high-beta (de-levered) factor (n = **4,583** days):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **BAB return** | **+0.54 bps/day** |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | **+0.31** |
| one-sample *t* | +0.25 |
| gross annualized Sharpe | +0.06 |
| CAPM alpha (HAC) | **+2.86 bps/day** (*t* = **+1.61**) |
| realized market beta of the book | **−0.83** |
| low-beta leg / high-beta leg | +1.60 bps (β_L 0.56) / +3.84 bps (β_H 1.45) |

The claimed edge **does not replicate.** Neither the raw beta-neutral factor (NW *t* = +0.31)
nor the CAPM alpha (*t* = +1.61) clears |t| ≥ 2. Worse, the book's **realized** market beta is
**−0.83**, far from the ex-ante-neutral 0: the multi-asset "low-beta" long leg is dominated by
long Treasuries and gold, so this factor is really a disguised **long-duration / short-equity**
tilt rather than a clean security-market-line arbitrage. The high-beta leg actually *out-earned*
the low-beta leg gross (+3.84 vs +1.60 bps) — the opposite of the flat-SML prediction, though
the leverage rescaling is what makes the netted factor roughly flat.

## Placebo — is the (weak) result a lucky alignment of the beta sort?

Keep the leverage structure but shuffle **which** asset each leg holds (beta → return link
broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed BAB | **+0.54 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +3.515 bps (1.528) |
| two-sided p | **0.984** (≈ 1.95σ, on the **low** side of the cloud) |

Because the levered book is mechanically ~net-long the average asset, the permutation null
centres **above** zero (+3.5 bps). The observed +0.54 bps sits at the *low* end of that cloud
(two-sided p = 0.98): the actual beta mapping adds **nothing** positive over a random
relabelling — if anything it slightly *underperforms* the mechanical net-long tilt. No evidence
of a tradable beta→return signal.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2016-07-01)

| era | BAB | NW *t* | alpha *t* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| 2007-04 → 2016-07 (n=2,071) | +3.70 bps | +1.20 | **+1.95** |
| 2016-07 → 2026-06 (n=2,512) | −2.07 bps | −1.12 | −0.25 |

The factor showed a *weak* flat-SML alpha before 2016 (alpha *t* = +1.95, just short of
significance) and **sign-flipped** afterward (−0.25). Not a stable edge.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge realized daily turnover × one-way × NAV on the ~2.6×-gross levered book; short leg pays
50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/day | cost/day | net/day | *t* (net) | NW *t* | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | +0.54 bps | 0.17 bps | **+0.37 bps** | +0.17 | +0.22 | 0.04 | +0.9%/yr |
| **5 bps** | +0.54 bps | 0.45 bps | **+0.09 bps** | +0.04 | +0.05 | 0.01 | +0.2%/yr |

The factor is flat gross and stays flat net — every net *t* is well under 1. Avg gross leverage
2.62×, avg daily turnover 0.071 of NAV. **Mirage.**

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded panel: assets with dispersed **true** betas load on a common market
factor; `edge>0` plants a flat-SML alpha (low-beta over-, high-beta under-priced). No network.

| world | BAB NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`edge = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **+0.12** (sd 0.89), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 1/20 seeds** (≈ nominal 5%) |
| planted (`edge = 0.0006`, seed 830) | **+3.55** (alpha *t* = +3.92, Sharpe +1.06) |

The detector recovers a *planted* flat-SML premium cleanly and fires on the null only at the
nominal false-positive rate — so the null real-tape result is a genuine absence, not a broken
engine. *(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The multi-asset BAB factor earns **+0.54 bps/day** (NW *t* = **+0.31**); as
  a CAPM alpha only **+2.86 bps/day** (HAC *t* = +1.61) — neither is significant. The book's
  realized market beta is **−0.83** (a disguised long-duration / short-equity bet, not a clean
  SML arbitrage), it worked only weakly pre-2016 (alpha *t* = +1.95) and reversed after (−0.25),
  and a 1,000-permutation placebo shows the beta sort adds nothing beyond the mechanical net-long
  tilt (observed +0.54 vs cloud mean +3.52, two-sided p = 0.98). The 20-seed synthetic control
  recovers a *planted* flat-SML premium cleanly. The famous flat SML is **not flat enough across
  asset classes** to constitute a signal here.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** Flat gross, flat net: +0.37 bps/day at 1 bp (*t* = +0.17), +0.09 at
  5 bps — indistinguishable from zero at any cost, on a 2.6×-gross levered book.
